content: Ransyerano weotor Israel maemembe akare Sion rai

content.text: Nai mana akokoeyo njam anyi no munijo Babel ama tuga,
wantantuna wamoyov wansaemembe akato Sion rai.
Nai mana tuga umaso,
wamo wama itari
ravesea nsaawa
inyo gandarusa rai.
Weye vatano wo wansaijaro arove wo wansantitidi
wangkinyo ransyerane raijo mansai.
Vatano wo wansatawanto umaso wo wansantitidi
indamu wangkinyo ransyerano marinsawane rai, muno wo wansakekebe ware:
‘‘Wakinyo ransyerano wakiny dai we no Sion inta raijo reansai!’’
Abo! Ransyerano wangkiny daive AMISY Ai mamo,
no munijo marane so, mamaisyo wangkiny dai ramu!
Inya, Yerusalem, ranivara inaemen akato winai jewen,
weamo inanem ngkove so maindi kai,
ti mo itari raeyan akato kakai!
Ranivara inanimari Yerusalem winai,
muno rinanayanambe manakoe winai akato rave jewen,
weamo inaunane so ntumainy kai indamu rikiny akatoe jewen.
Sya AMISY, syare naemeno vatano Edom awa ana udave rai, muno Nyo mangke rasakinavo mai.
Onawamo arono naito Babel wo Yerusalem randujai we,
wo raura ware: ‘‘Randamisyi! Randamisyi rave ramu masyo ruke rai rave!’’
Inya, munijo Babel, winyamo indati naupaeta ti nakanive!
Weye nyo reansave tatugadi,
weti syare kove ngkov irati vatano indati po mangke rasakinavo winai ai.
Kove ngkov irati vatano po Babel nya arikainyo tuvane marigwainye ai,
muno po maugaje mavari no orame rai ai.

footnotes.text: itari ravesea nsaawa: ama ine mare vatano Israel wonae wo awa itari so raeyambe akato no munijo aroo ratuije, weye mansaemen akare awa munijo Sion rai.
Wusyinoe, arono naite wo awa marova mapinde, weamo wo marova awa arikainye maugaje mavari no orame rai. 2Raj. 8:12; Yes. 13:16; Nahum 3:10
